item.title: Rate held at 6.25 per cent as inflation eases
item.description: Ordelia's central bank held its benchmark rate steady at 6.25 per cent. The monetary committee voted five to one, according to the statement.

item.title: Uncrewed crew-capsule test flight set for 12 December
item.description: The agency confirmed 12 December as the opening of the launch window. Officials said the flight will carry no crew and will test the escape system.
